name: Aladdin
description: A youth on whose finger a magician placed a ring.

description_citations.text: Fourth Edition: card flavor text (Fourth Edition, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The magician puts a talisman ring on Aladdin's finger.
timeline.quote: the magician drew a ring off his finger, and put it on one of Aladdin's

citation.text: Aladdin's Ring (Arabian Nights, 1993), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: The ring is a talisman so long as Aladdin obeys the magician.
relations.quote: It is a talisman against all evil, so long as you obey me.
